dataKeys.dataText: interfaceCopy keys resolved per language (R4 per-key English fallback)
dataKeys.dataFlavour: pack flavour string ids, resolved by the engine
dataKeys.dataCompanyExample: removed when no company example is supplied

scriptOrder: packs/<code>/behaviour.js where a pack declares script

packContract.styleMount: <style id="theme-<code>" media="not all"> — only the active pack is media="all"
packContract.bodyClass: pack-<code> on <body> while a pack is active
packContract.forbiddenZone: no decoration may anchor on #specContent or anything inside it
packContract.protectedText: +AI (exact case), URLs, identifiers and code are never translated (T0)

navigationHooks.status: route block rendered by the engine from src/nav.json; destination pages ship additively (recorded exception: none exist at contract v1)

neutralRoute.budget: the neutral pack's own CSS stays below 20 KB (docs/development/0001 D1's 100 KB budget governs the neutral route's added weight; the shared engine remains the single-file baseline)
neutralRoute.reachableVia: ?theme=neutral, the Theme selector, and automatically when a requested pack fails

versionSlot.element: #specFingerprint — 12-char sha256 fingerprint of SPECIFICATION.md, linking to it for verification
versionSlot.hashDefinition: UTF-8, line endings normalised to \n, trailing newline stripped

parameters.canonicalForm: query parameters are order-insensitive; canonical links sort parameters by key (url-semantics-and-canonicalization-dsh.md §5.2.4)
parameters.resolution: theme: ?theme= → saved plus-ai-theme → default (sci-fi-1); language: ?lang= → saved plus-ai-language → browser → en (R12); only explicit choices are persisted
